final: WITH account_orders AS (SELECT o.account_id, d.A3 AS region, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM "order" AS o JOIN disp AS owner ON owner.account_id = o.account_id AND owner.type = 'OWNER' JOIN client AS c ON c.client_id = owner.client_id JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = c.district_id GROUP BY o.account_id, d.A3), differences AS (SELECT account_id, region, order_count, order_count - (SELECT AVG(order_count) FROM account_orders) AS difference FROM account_orders), regional_averages AS (SELECT region, AVG(difference) AS average_difference FROM differences GROUP BY region) SELECT x.account_id, x.region, x.order_count, x.difference, x.difference - r.average_difference AS excess_over_region_average FROM differences AS x JOIN regional_averages AS r ON r.region = x.region WHERE x.difference > r.average_difference ORDER BY excess_over_region_average DESC LIMIT 10
